en: With pay on delivery, your customer pays you, the shop, when the parcel arrives: with the link we send to their phone and email, or the rider's QR code (or you mark it paid if they paid you another way). Then they get a code, the rider types it in, and only then is the parcel handed over. Riders and delivery partners never collect your money. When you take card payments, the delivery fee can be paid at checkout.
pcm: With pay on delivery, your customer go pay you, the shop, when the parcel land: with the link wey we send to their phone and email, or the rider QR code (or you mark am paid if dem pay you another way). Then dem go get code, the rider go type am, na only then dem go give the parcel. Riders and delivery partners no dey ever collect your money. When you dey take card payment, dem fit pay the delivery fee for checkout.
yo: Pẹ̀lú sísanwó nígbà tí ó bá dé, oníbàárà rẹ yóò san owó fún ọ, ṣọ́ọ̀bù, nígbà tí ẹrù bá dé: pẹ̀lú ìjápọ̀ tí a fi ránṣẹ́ sí fóònù àti ímeèlì wọn, tàbí QR code ọlọ́kadà (tàbí kí o sàmì sí i pé wọ́n ti sanwó). Lẹ́yìn náà wọn yóò gba kóòdù, ọlọ́kadà yóò tẹ̀ ẹ́, kí wọ́n tó fi ẹrù lé wọn lọ́wọ́. Àwọn ọlọ́kadà àti ilé-iṣẹ́ ìfijíṣẹ́ kì í gba owó rẹ.
ha: Da biya idan ya iso, kwastomanka zai biya ka, shagon, idan kayan sun iso: da mahaɗin da muke aikawa wayarsa da imel, ko QR code na mahayi (ko ka nuna an biya idan ya biya ka ta wata hanya). Sai ya samu lamba, mahayi ya rubuta ta, sannan a ba shi kayan. Mahaya da kamfanonin isarwa ba sa karɓar kuɗinka.
ig: Na ịkwụ ụgwọ mgbe ọ rutere, onye ahịa gị na-akwụ gị, ụlọ ahịa, ụgwọ mgbe ngwugwu rutere: site na njikọ anyị na-ezitere ekwentị na email ha, ma ọ bụ QR code nke onye na-ebuga (ma ọ bụ ị kaa ya akara na akwụọla ya). Mgbe ahụ ha ga-enweta koodu, onye na-ebuga ga-etinye ya, tupu e nye ngwugwu ahụ. Ndị na-ebuga ihe anaghị ana ego gị.

en: With pay on delivery, the customer pays the shop, never you or your rider: with the link we send them or your rider's QR code. Once it's paid they get a code; your rider types it in and the app says Paid, then hands over the parcel. Your riders never collect cash for these orders.

yo: Pẹ̀lú sísanwó nígbà tí ó bá dé, oníbàárà ń san owó fún ṣọ́ọ̀bù, kì í ṣe ìwọ tàbí ọlọ́kadà rẹ: pẹ̀lú ìjápọ̀ tí a fi ránṣẹ́ sí wọn tàbí QR code ọlọ́kadà rẹ. ha: Da biya idan ya iso, kwastoma yana biyan shagon, ba kai ko mahayinka ba: da mahaɗin da muka aika masa ko QR code na mahayinka. Da zarar ya biya zai samu lamba; mahayinka zai rubuta ta, manhajar ta ce Paid, sannan ya ba da kayan. Mahayanka ba sa karɓar kuɗi a hannu.
ig: Na ịkwụ ụgwọ mgbe ọ rutere, onye ahịa na-akwụ ụlọ ahịa ụgwọ, ọ bụghị gị ma ọ bụ onye na-ebugara gị: site na njikọ anyị zitere ha ma ọ bụ QR code nke onye na-ebugara gị.
